# Careers at Leena AI

Growth100–1000 employeesAIWilmington, DelawareSan Francisco, CaliforniaGurgaon, Haryana, India

Leena AI empowers employees using “AI Colleagues” to get answers and take action across IT, HR, Finance, Procurement and beyond through a single intelligent interface. Our customers boost productivity and reduce the volume of manually handled requests by 70%.

Rapid deployment through integrations with 200+ enterprise systems, such as ServiceNow, SAP, Workday, UKG, Atlassian, and Salesforce, and a large number of customizable agentic workflows out of the box. Employees interact via voice, Slack, Teams, text, and other means.

Leena AI is the world’s largest independent employee‑facing Agentic AI Colleague, serving hundreds of enterprises worldwide such as Nestlé, Coca-Cola, Assurant, MongoDB, CHRISTUS Health, Sony, and Etihad Airways. Recognized by Gartner as a Leader in Agentic AI. Founded in 2018, Leena AI supports 100+ languages globally, and millions of employees use the work assistant daily.

For more information, visit https://leena.ai.
